summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of 3.5 million Class B ordinary shares (10 votes each) to its founder/CEO, Terence Zou, upon satisfaction of performance milestones tied to prior capital raises. No price or premium is stated. The issuance increases Zou's beneficial ownership to 19.7 million Class B shares (11.59% of share capital, 56.74% of voting power). The Class B shares are not listed on NYSE American. This is a routine equity issuance under existing authorization, not a stand-alone special situation. No advisory, recommendation, or risk-arb angle applies.
